name: slack
author: John P. Giatropoulos
description: Granular Slack widgets — browse channels, view messages, post messages, search, and check user status.

widgets.name: SlackListChannels
widgets.description: Scrollable list of Slack channels with search filter. Click to select a channel.

widgets.name: SlackChannelMessages
widgets.description: Displays message history for a Slack channel. Auto-refreshes on channel selection.

widgets.name: SlackPostMessage
widgets.description: Compose and send messages to a Slack channel. Auto-fills channel from selection.

widgets.name: SlackSearchMessages
widgets.description: Search Slack messages across channels with context snippets.

widgets.name: SlackUserStatus
widgets.description: View and update your Slack user status with emoji and text.

widgets.name: SlackWidget
widgets.description: List channels and send messages via the Slack MCP provider.
